title: Hidden Cameras & Harassment
description: Learn how to identify hidden cameras in public spaces and how to handle and report public harassment.

scenes.text: You are at a shopping mall and go to use the public changing room to try on clothes. You've heard stories about hidden cameras in fitting rooms.
How can you check if the mirror in the room is a two-way mirror?

choices.text: Place your fingernail against the glass. If there is a gap between your nail and the reflection, it's a genuine mirror.
choices.feedbackText: Correct! If there is a gap, it's a normal mirror. If your fingernail directly touches its reflection with no gap, it might be a two-way mirror.

choices.text: Knock on it to see if it breaks easily.
choices.feedbackText: Knocking won't reliably tell you, and breaking the glass is dangerous. Use the fingernail test instead.

scenes.text: The mirror is normal. However, you leave the mall and a group of guys starts passing inappropriate comments (catcalling) as you walk by.
You feel unsafe. What is the Women Helpline number in India you can call?

choices.feedbackText: Correct! 1091 is the Women Helpline in India. It is toll-free and available 24/7.
1098 is Childline. For adult women's distress and anti-harassment, 1091 is the dedicated Women Helpline.

scenes.text: You confidently walk into a nearby crowded store, ignoring the harassers, and call a family member. Harassment is never your fault, and you have the right to occupy public spaces safely.
